meta.title: The River Fare: a 60 second film about a dollar crossing to Bitcoin Cash
meta.description: A paper rower carries one dollar coin across a river to the Bitcoin Cash bank and pays a fare of less than a tenth of a US cent. A 60 second animated film with English narration and captions.

hero.kicker: Animated short film, 60 seconds, narrated in English
hero.title: The River Fare
hero.lede: A toll bridge takes a big coin from every traveller. A small rower carries one dollar coin across the river to the Bitcoin Cash bank instead, and pays a fare of less than a tenth of a US cent.

short.text: Also: a vertical cut of under 20 seconds for phone feeds.

facts.title: What the film says
facts.fee: A real Bitcoin Cash transfer on 15 November 2026 paid a fee of [[fee]]219 satoshis[[/fee]], less than a tenth of a US cent at that day's price.
facts.pusd: PUSD is a dollar stablecoin token on Bitcoin Cash, designed to hold a value of one US dollar.
facts.note: One measured transfer, not a promise about every future fee. Nothing here is investment advice.

ai.title: How it was made, and where AI was used
ai.clips: The video clips are generated by an AI video model through the VE Studio API, from written text prompts. Every request and its cost is logged.
ai.scale: The 1920 x 1080 picture is scaled up from 1280 x 720 clips with ffmpeg (lanczos). No AI upscaler.
ai.music: The music is synthesised by code written with an AI coding agent. No samples, no AI music service.
ai.text: Captions, the end card and the thumbnail title are drawn by code.
ai.credit: Direction and review: Muhammad Aiman. Tools: Claude Code.
ai.voice: Narration: an AI clone of the maker's own voice (ElevenLabs), reading the on-screen captions.
